citation: Alexis Cook, DanB, inversion, Ryan Holbrook (2021). Store Sales – Time Series Forecasting. Kaggle.
caveats: Real historical data from Corporación Favorita (Ecuador), Kaggle. Not UAE data.
Sales are observed sales, not unconstrained demand: stock-outs and lost sales are not visible.
Scope: 12 stores × 8 families = 96 daily series, stores chosen with data before the first selection origin.
Promotion = count of promoted items in the family on a day. Promotion effects shown are model-predicted associations, not causal uplift.
Prediction intervals are empirical 80 % targets from calibration residuals, not guarantees.
The Trust score is a 0–100 ranking index, not a probability that the forecast is right.
UAE Scenario Lab values are editable demonstration assumptions, not measured UAE uplift.
Forecast value added (FVA) on the S&OP page is a simulated, rule-based override, not human-planner performance.
The holdout was evaluated once; the forward window 2017-08-16 to 2017-08-29 has no actuals.

headline: On 6 weeks of holdout it never saw, LightGBM cut forecast error to 12.6 % WAPE from 17.2 % for the best baseline, and Review-band forecasts went on to show 1.96× the error of Accept-band ones.
